args.command: node --version; npm --version; ls -la; git status 2>&1 | head -20
npm ls nanoid 2>&1; echo "---"; cat node_modules/nanoid/package.json 2>&1 | head -20; echo "--- lockfile ---"; ls -la package-lock.json 2>&1
npm config get registry; echo "--- available versions ---"; npm view nanoid versions --json 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "--- dist-tags ---"; npm view nanoid dist-tags 2>&1
npm ls 2>&1; echo "--- exit: $? ---"; echo "--- nanoid tree ---"; npm ls nanoid 2>&1; echo "--- exit: $? ---"
find node_modules -maxdepth 2 -type d 2>&1 | head; echo "--- nanoid files ---"; ls -la node_modules/nanoid/ 2>&1; echo "--- lockfile ---"; cat package-lock.json 2>&1
echo "=== package.json ==="; cat package.json; echo; echo "=== files ==="; ls -la
